title: Convenient
summary: CONVENIENT, adjective Fit; suitable; proper; adapted to use or to wants; commodious; followed by to or for; usually by for. Some arts are peculiarly convenient to particular nations. Feed me with food

inlines.v: CONVENIENT, adjective Fit; suitable; proper; adapted to use or to wants; commodious; followed by to or for; usually by for. Some arts are peculiarly convenient to particular nations. Feed me with food convenient for me. Proverbs 30:8.
